description: What the user was trying to do, in plain language, for every Manager operation that can fail. The support report quotes `intent` verbatim, so a stranger's AI knows the goal before it reads the log. `operation` is the id the Rust run recorder stores; `commands` are the #[tauri::command] names in NPDevManager/src/main.rs that record under it (verified 2026-10-31 against main.rs at fc4ff17e). `glossary` links to help-glossary.json ids.

intents.intent: install Java (JDK 17), the runtime generated apps run on
commonCauses: no internet or a proxy blocks the download
no write permission to the install folder

intents.intent: install Python, which runs NPDev's own tools
commonCauses: the Microsoft Store 'python' alias shadows the real one

intents.intent: download and install an NPDev version
commonCauses: GitHub rate limit or no internet
folder in use by a running app

intents.intent: switch which NPDev version the Manager uses
commonCauses: the chosen folder is not an NPDev checkout or release

intents.intent: prepare NPDev's building blocks on this computer (npdev setup)
commonCauses: a file locked by an editor or antivirus

intents.intent: check whether this computer can build and run NPDev apps
create a new app from a starter model
turn the app's model into a runnable program
commonCauses: the model has a validation error (the log names the field)
generator version older than the model

intents.intent: rebuild the app after a platform change
commonCauses: a file locked by the IDE (bump the build folder suffix)

intents.intent: start the app so it can be opened in a browser
stop a running app
test the connection to the app's database
create, reset or migrate the app's database
commonCauses: the database user may read but not create tables

intents.intent: export the app's data to files
import data files into the app's database
commonCauses: file columns do not match the concept
the app is running and holds the database

intents.intent: start Docker Desktop for a database container
give the app a temporary public link (tunnel)
deploy the app to an external host
test the connection to an AI provider
commonCauses: model not offered on the free tier

intents.intent: let an AI build or change the app in a loop
commonCauses: the model returned something that is not a valid NPDev model

intents.intent: start the browser-check engine
run browser checks against the app
run the AI evaluation scenarios
check which existing rows a model change would break
apply an edit to the running app
commonCauses: the change needs a rebuild, not a live apply
